verdict.rationale: Requesty documents cross-provider tool translation only for its native web search tool: you pass a single tool definition and Requesty converts it to each provider's format. The pack never documents general user-defined function calling across providers. Its OpenAI-compatible API and its consistent structured-output behavior are adjacent features, not tool-calling evidence. missing for 10: documented general function/tool calling across providers, consistent tool-call response schema, streaming tool-call deltas, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can make tool and function calls across different providers with a consistent schema

citations.quote: Pass a single tool definition and Requesty translates it to the right provider format automatically.
